name: Family Reunification / Automatic Entitlement to a Residence Card

qualifying_event.description: Article 17 of Law 02-03 lists categories of foreigners automatically entitled to a residence card: the spouse and minor children of an existing residence-card holder (no separate reunification procedure needed), foreign parents exercising guardianship/custody or providing material support for a Moroccan-national child residing in Morocco, and dependent foreign grandparents of a Moroccan citizen.
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: Marriage/filiation documentation; proof of the sponsor's residence-card status or Moroccan nationality; for parents/grandparents, proof of dependency and kinship.

requirement_groups.name: Spouse or minor child of a residence-card holder

requirements.blocker_text: Automatic entitlement for the spouse and minor children of an existing Moroccan residence-card holder, with marriage/filiation documentation but no separate reunification procedure required.
A foreign parent exercising legal guardianship, custody, or providing material support for a child who has acquired Moroccan nationality and resides in Morocco.

requirement_groups.name: Dependent grandparent of a Moroccan citizen

requirements.blocker_text: A foreign grandparent who is a dependent of a Moroccan citizen and their spouse, with documentation proving kinship and financial dependency.

evidence_required.document: Proof of the sponsor's status (residence card or Moroccan nationality)
Proof of dependency/kinship (parent and grandparent cases)

outcome.duration_length: 1 year initially, renewable (general carte d'immatriculation progression: 1yr, then 2-3yr, 5yr, 10yr on successive renewals)
outcome.physical_presence_requirement: card lapses after 6 months' continuous absence from Morocco

sources.title: GADEM legal guide -- Article 17 of Law 02-03, cases of automatic entitlement ('délivrance de plein droit') to a residence card: spouse/minor children of a cardholder, parents of a Moroccan-national child, dependent grandparents of a Moroccan citizen, refugees' families, long-term residents

STATUS: DRAFT -- sourced entirely to GADEM's summary of Article 17 rather than an independently verified primary legislative text (the Dahir/Loi 02-03 text itself was not independently fetched in this pass). This file deliberately excludes the foreign-spouse-of-a-MOROCCAN-CITIZEN case, which is instead modeled separately in ma_citizenship_by_marriage.json (Article 10 -- a citizenship route, not merely a residence one, though also listed as a plein-droit residence case per Article 17). Refugees-and-their-families and long-term-residents cases from the same Article 17 list are modeled separately in ma_international_protection.json and ma_long_term_residence.json respectively, since they have materially different qualifying events.
